$description: The touch density: phone, foldable, tablet. Source: Foundations (Web and phones), Components (Buttons, Forms).

control-sm.$description: The height of a small button: tables and dense toolbars

control-md.$description: The height of a medium button: most actions

control-lg.$description: The height of a large button: a primary action on its own

icon.$description: The size of an icon in a control

code-box-width.$description: The width of a box of the code entry. Six touch boxes fit in a phone form

code-box-height.$description: The height of a box of the code entry

small.$description: The label of a small button

title-2.$description: The title-2 size: statistic values and the digits of the code entry.

title-3.$description: title-3: card titles. The line height is 20 px for pointer and 22 px for touch.

caption.$description: Labels and badges, the initials of a small avatar

field-gap.$description: The gap between the fields of a form
